item.title: Attorney General Alert: Changes to Medicare Advantage plans dramatically changing care options for nearly 400,000 older Minnesotans
item.description:
Publication Date: November 02, 2026

Nearly one-third of Minnesotans on Medicare, many in Greater Minnesota, will lose their Medicare Advantage plan in 2027 — 18 Minnesota counties will have no Medicare Advantage coverage, three will have only Original Medicare as an option
